rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server exposes Helixar's agentic AI security tools directly in Claude and other MCP-compatible clients. It provides three tools: scanning MCP servers against Sentinel detection rules for risk assessment, validating agentic delegation chains per IETF draft standards, and wrapping the ReleaseGuard tool to scan release artifacts for secrets and license gaps. The server is deployed on Cloudflare Workers and supports both remote HTTP and local stdio operation.
